editorial_scope: Six new reader essays select the principal arguments and fictional cases of Mutual Trust through The Close; not a complete technical translation of every proposition or classical comparison.
English is independently written around the same scenes, qualifications and unresolved outcomes. Traditional Chinese contains the complete Chinese body, not a shortened edition.

Acts, amounts, decision-makers and dissent are recorded; national character, hidden bargains and unrecorded retaliation are not invented. Later conduct neither erases earlier debts nor proves an institutional cause.

Withholding cooperation, confiscating principal, and rendering refusal practically impossible remain distinct; freezes need review and cannot be extended merely by renaming them. The existence of a loss does not compel indefinite renewal.
Votes, national implementation and common design have separate responsibility. A humanitarian exception on paper is not proof that supplies arrived.

Each deployment needs its own national grounds, answerable decision and limited mandate. Invitation, membership and the common record do not substitute for that judgment. The fictional model does not determine actual alliance law.

No deployment is not no responsibility: noncombat aid and withdrawal of weapons, logistics and transit support remain distinct from a blanket trade blockade. Genuine division and defence do not authorize expansion for the protected side.

Reception must not become ownership of the person. The commander is explicitly a separate hypothetical with no supplied outcome; protection against specified treatment does not erase responsibility or mandate prosecution without applicable law.

Protection at the door, optional additional support and expressly accepted sharing commitments remain distinct. Choice is not an entitlement to compel admission anywhere, nor is nominal refusal sufficient if unusable in practice.

Withdrawal can end a particular procedure without erasing prior conduct. Existing proceedings and newly filed cases are distinguished under the accepted rule; the seven returned petitions are a real loss, not replaced by general external questioning.
Readmission is a new agreement; expulsion and dissolution remain answerable acts with costs for affected people. Institutional obligation is not inherited personal guilt.

The final essay does not establish the resident's petition standing, attribute fuel prices without evidence, or equate an alert with a verified count of lives saved. Domestic enforcement is not reclassified as common enforcement.

No guarantee of stability, compliance or rescue is added. Partial cooperation and unresolved harm are kept on the same page; current law and every real international institution are not described by this fictional model.
